narrative:
Van Wert County has 19,929 registered voters, with 12.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 47.0%, a clear Democratic lean of 9.0 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.3% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -15.0% D−R vs -40.5% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
